title: Siri AI is already changing how I use my iPhone
slides: Siri just learned something surprising about my habits.
It now anticipates actions before I finish thinking.
But it failed on a request I make every morning.
You can override its guesses with one simple tap.
Test your own routine against Siri's predictions today.
thread_text:
1. It knows before you do.

Siri started predicting my morning routine without me touching the phone. The guess was right two days in a row.

2. The one thing it missed.

Every morning I ask for the same playlist. This time it offered a podcast instead. A pattern it should have learned.

3. You can kill the guess.

One tap clears its prediction and resets the suggestion. The override works instantly, no settings needed.

4. Why it broke the habit.

The algorithm favors novelty over routine. Your repeated request gets buried by new data unless you force it.

5. Test your own routine today.

Open Siri right now and say your usual morning phrase. Does it guess right or wrong? Reply with your result.
